guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice has the largest anomalies in the digest: memory up 1876% (z=+375) and CPU up 4411% (z=+220), with latency-90 up 764%, while its downstream callees (paymentservice, emailservice, currencyservice) show negligible change. Memory has the highest z-score, but CPU rose at the same time and the digest cannot cleanly separate the two (logs are empty, with no errors), so mem vs cpu is a judgment call.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the checkoutservice pods to clear the memory growth, then inspect heap/profile data and the memory limits to find the leak or allocation source. Hold off on a restart if in-flight checkouts must be preserved, and drain traffic first.
